popup.title: Nunwood
popup.description: The main source of lumber for [[Reth]] and [[Hlath]], protected by the [[Emerald Enclave]] and creatures that used hit-and-run tactics during the night.

popup.title: Chondalwood
popup.description: Also known as the '''Satyrwood''', the large forest was located in [[Chondath]] in the [[Vilhon Reach]], stretching from the [[Nunwood]] to the [[Nagaflow River]]. It is also known as Satyrwood.

popup.title: Maerchwood
popup.description: The forest in the southern heartlands of [[Chessenta]], between the [[Adder River]] and the [[Winding River]].

popup.title: Methwood
popup.description: A dense forest located in the frontier between the nations of [[Chessenta]] and [[Unther]].

popup.title: Sharawood
popup.description: A haunted forest also knoen as the '''Drakewood''', located along the coast of the [[Gulf of Luiren]], overrun with monsters and [[undead]].

popup.title: Riftwood
popup.description: An isolated forest located about 50 miles (80.5 kilometers) east of the [[Great Rift]], home to a variety of animals and beasts, including [[snake]]s, [[panther]]s, and [[giant beetle]]s.

popup.title: Ganathwood
popup.description: A small forest found in the northern regions of [[Murghôm]], a minor source of wood for [[Mulhorand]], exporting it to [[Thay]].

popup.title: Aerilpar Forest
popup.description: Or the '''Wood of Dark Trees''' a monster-infested forest rumored to have its trees animated by a foul [[wizard]].

popup.title: Gundar Forest
popup.description: A small forest at the mouth of the [[River Gundar]].
popup.image: File:The Shining Lands - The Shining South 1993.jpg

popup.title: Lluirwood
popup.description: Also known as the '''Long Fores'''. It spanned 300 miles (480 km) east to west across [[Luiren]] and was roughly 90 miles (145 km) wide.

popup.title: Southern Lluirwood
popup.description: Or the '''Granuin Forest''', a mostly untamed wood, although the eastern border was patrolled by militia and [[halfling]] [[ranger]]s and [[druid]]s.

popup.title: Forest of Amtar
popup.description: A lush forest of heat and humidity, majority of which trees were [[suthwood]]. The dangerous woods were filled with [[choke creepers]], [[assassin vines]], [[roper]]s, and [[giant rhinoceros beetle]]s among other creatures.

popup.title: Duskwood
popup.description: The deepest and most untamed forest in the [[Border Kingdoms]] between the [[Realm of the Smoking Star]] and the [[Realm of the Ready Sword]].

popup.title: Shaarwood
popup.description: A small forest found in the western [[Shaar]].

popup.title: Channathwood
popup.description: A small forest found in the southern [[Shaar]].

popup.title: Misty Vale
popup.description: A hot, dense jungle east of the [[Dun Hills]] and north of the [[Bandit Wastes]], home to predatory horrors descended from [[Ilythiiri]] [[sorcerer]]s' castoff experiments.

popup.title: Shaareach Forest
popup.description: A small forest found in the southern [[Shaar]] near the plains of the [[Shaareach]].

popup.title: Mhair Jungles
popup.description: A prominent jungle forest found in southern [[Tashalar]] on the [[Chultan Peninsula]].

popup.title: Neth Stand
popup.description: A dark, thick forest on the [[Lake of Steam]] that contained underground volcanic vents that emitted sulfurous mists.

popup.title: Black Jungles
popup.description: A heavily forested region of southern [[Tashalar]].

popup.title: Ankhwood
popup.description: A forest whose insect, animal, and plant populations mutated by ''[[wild magic]]'' and ''[[dead magic]]'' areas orbiting one another.

popup.title: Winterwood
popup.description: A [[pine]] and [[oak]]-filled woodland inhabited by [[orc]]s, [[green dragon]]s, and [[green elves]].

popup.title: Thornwood
popup.description: The forest to the north of the city of [[Ankhapur]], known for its deadly flora - [[thornslinger]]s, [[choke creeper]]s, [[retch plant]]s, [[yellow musk creeper]]s, and many more dangerous and more intelligent plants.

popup.title: Qurth Forest
popup.description: A wild forest that bordered the forest with the [[Barony of the Great Oak]], surrounded by many towns and ruins.

popup.title: Jundarwood
popup.description: A forest of note in the [[Border Kingdoms]].

popup.title: Forest of Lethyr
popup.description: One of the two forests that comprised the borders of the [[Great Dale]], guarded by [[druid]]s and [[ranger]]s as well as a few [[treant]]s.

popup.title: Gray Forest
popup.description: Also known as the '''Tsurlar Forest''' with circles of the grand, gray-barked [[tree]]s with dark leaves that the [[moon elves]] who once dwelt here had turned themselves into.

popup.title: Yuirwood
popup.description: The ancient forest at the center of the nation of [[Aglarond]], named after the [[Yuir]], an ancient race of [[star elves]] who once dwelled in the forest.

popup.title: Border Forest
popup.description: Also known as the '''Rystall Woos''', a large forest of [[pine]]s, [[oak]]s, and other deciduous trees with thick hard-to-traverse undergrowth, inhabited mostly by [[fey]].

popup.title: Forest of Tethir
popup.description: Also known as [[Wealdath]], the largest forest in the [[Lands of Intrigue]] and the "single most important thing" that set the culture of [[Tethyr]].

popup.title: Duskwood Dell
popup.description: The most sacred site of [[Eldath]] located in [[Faerûn]].

popup.title: Snakewood
popup.description: A relatively small forest located in eastern [[Amn]], named after a great number of black and green [[snake]]s that lived there.

popup.title: High Forest
popup.description: A a vast forested remnant of the days of old, when all of [[Faerûn]] was covered in green and [[elves]], [[giant]]s, and [[dragon]]s ruled the world.

popup.title: Swanmay's Glade
popup.description: A portion of the [[Wealdath]] forest where the [[Nebulae Pool]] and the [[Calathalureenteir]] could be found.

popup.title: Moonglade
popup.description: Or the '''Seeding Forest''' as of the late 14{{th}} century [[DR]].

popup.title: Syldritch Trea
popup.description:
Ancient trees within the [[Shilmista]] forest, once menaced by evil [[wizard]] [[Dorigen Kel Lamond]] in [[1361 DR]].

'''Note: This map shows the incorrect geography of the region. Please refer to 2{{nd}} edition maps.'''

popup.title: Shilmista
popup.description:
Or the '''Forest of Shadows''' that encompassed the kingdom of the [[wild elf]] [[Elbereth]].

'''Note: This map shows the incorrect geography of the region. Please refer to 2{{nd}} edition maps.'''

popup.title: Bowgentle's Grove
popup.description:
A calm glade in the south of the forest and the burial place of the [[wizard]] [[Bowgentle]].

'''Note: This map shows the incorrect geography of the region. Please refer to 2{{nd}} edition maps.'''

popup.title: Cloak Wood
popup.description: An ancient, thickly grown forest in the [[Western Heartlands]], infested by [[giant spider]]s, [[korred]]s, [[kampfult]]s, [[quickling]]s, [[satyr]]s, [[stirge]]s, and other deadly creatures.

popup.title: Hullack Forest
popup.description: A forest that was once a part of the huge forest of [[Cormanthor]].

popup.title: Wood of Sharp Teeth
popup.description: Or '''Glimmerwood''', a dense forest where one could gather [[maiden's milk]] and [[bellows root]] [[herb]]s, inhabited by  [[satyr]]s, [[dryad]]s, and a small number of [[werewolves]].

popup.title: Hermit's Wood
popup.description: A large forest in southern [[Cormyr]], lying southwest of [[Wheloon]] – a common destination for foragers, hunters, and loggers.

popup.title: The Redwoods
popup.description: A. small forest at the [[River Arabel]]'s begging on the edge of the [[Helmhands]].

popup.title: King's Forest
popup.description: The forest that belonged to the Crown of [[Cormyr]], once home to [[elves]] but abandoned to humankind.

popup.title: Misty Forest
popup.description: A fog-filled, rainy forest, west of the [[High Moor]], that was also an [[elf|elven]] kingdom.

popup.title: Reaching Woods
popup.description: A large forest in the [[Western Heartlands]] with its northern offshoot being called the '''Northdark Wood'''.

popup.title: Forest of Wyrms
popup.description: Also known as '''Ss'kowlyn'raa'' by the [[yuan-ti]], a dark and dangerous forest of  [[pine]]s and tall [[redwood]] [[tree]]s.

popup.title: South Wood
popup.description: A forest within the [[Triangle of Trees]] in the [[Savage Frontier]], a popular stomping grounds for the outdoorsmen of [[Gray Vale]].

popup.title: Tanglefork Woods
popup.description: A small forest in the [[Grayvale]], at the southwestern fringe of the great [[High Forest]], between it and the [[River Delimbiyr]] and the [[Delimbiyr Road]] and just east of the [[Heartblood River]] where it joined the Delimbiyr.

popup.title: Forgotten Forest
popup.description: A small but mysterious forest of [[treant]]s and [[fey]] creatures found in the [[Backlands]] of the [[Western Heartlands]].

popup.title: Gulthmere Forest
popup.description: The forest that served as the rough boundary between the [[Dragon Coast]] and the [[Vilhon Reach]]. Overgrown with [[pine]] and [[cedar]], it was the "seat of power" for the Vilhonese [[druid]]s.

popup.title: Troll Claw Woods
popup.description: A small forested area of the [[Troll Claws]] infested with giant [[boring beetle|boring]] and [[bombardier beetle]]s, [[monstrous humanoid]]s, [[giant spider]], and, of corse, [[troll]]s.

popup.title: Coast Way Forest
popup.description: A minor forested area west of the [[Coast Way crossing]].

popup.title: Bloodbark Grove
popup.description: A grove of [[blackthorn tree]]s and [[belladonna]] plants in the southern stretch of the [[High Moor]], inhabited by greater [[basilisk]]s, [[dire wolves|dire]], as well as [[dread wolves]].

popup.title: Trollbark Forest
popup.description: A forest with low vales that hid a multitude of bogs and swamps, inhabited by [[giant slug]]s, [[fell troll]]s, and [[choker]]s.

popup.title: Brush of Barbs
popup.description: A secluded and thorny overgrown forest, home of [[Govan Irfandel|Irfandel]]'s druidic [[Stone Circle of Govan]].

popup.title: Dancing Forest
popup.description: A small forest that grew along the [[Turmway]] and sheltered the town of [[Centaur Bridge]], notable for its seemingly permanent thick white mist.

popup.title: The Faraway
popup.description: A great forest in [[Turmish]].

popup.title: Ardeep Forest
popup.description: Or the '''Faraway Forest''', a small but thick woodland that once encompassed much of the [[Sword Coast]], famed for its legendary [[Cloud palace|floating towers]].

popup.title: Laughing Hollow
popup.description: A preternatural valley upriver from [[Daggerford]], filled with trees so dense, they created a day's twilight underneath.

popup.title: Spiderhaunt Wood
popup.description: A dangerous forest where spellcasters of all types came to gather [[spider]]-related [[spell component]]s.

popup.title: Quivering Forest
popup.description: A forest stretching from the city of [[Phlan]] to the [[Dragonspine Mountains]], forming a border with the great gray waste of [[Thar]].

popup.title: Westwood
popup.description: A part of a group of forests referred to by some as the [[Other Woods]] and others as the [[Moonwoods]].The forests in this group were [[Lurkwood]], [[Southkrypt Garden]], [[Southwood]], [[Moonwood]], and [[Westwood]].

popup.title: Kryptgarden Forest
popup.description: Also known as '''Tsordvudd''', was a small but ancient and foreboding forest, once a site that once housed long-lost realms of the [[elves]] and [[dwarves]].

popup.title: Adhe Wood
popup.description: A forest infected with numerous arachnid monsters.

popup.title: Brynwood
popup.description: The forest that covered a large area between the [[Earthfast Mountains]] and the [[North Road]], lying north of the towns of [[Maerstar]] and [[Sevenecho]].

popup.title: Velarswood
popup.description: A forest near the center of [[Harrowdale]] with a temple to [[Eilistraee]] located in the north, which was guarded by a number of goodly [[drow]].

popup.title: Highbank Forest
popup.description:
A steeply sloped and wooded hill that laid just to the north of the Highbank Forest
Village; it provided shelter to the village against the strongest winter winds.

popup.title: Monarch's Fall Glade
popup.description: The part of [[Cormanthor]] where the [[green dragon|green]] [[dracolich]] named [[Dretchroyaster]] laired in the 1400s DR.

popup.title: The Darkwoods
popup.description: The part of [[Cormanthor]] infamous for the [[Darkwoods Massacre]] [[orc]]s and [[elves]] in [[335 DR]].

popup.title: Grove of Darkness
popup.description: A grove of note.

popup.title: Corellon's Glen
popup.description: A border portion of greater [[Cormanthor]].

popup.title: Tangled Vale
popup.description: A notable part of [[Cormanthor]].

popup.title: Arch Wood
popup.description: A dark and dense logging forest in [[Archendale]] filled with [[oak]]s, [[ash]]es, [[elm]]s, [[shadowtop]]s, and [[duskwood]]s.

popup.title: Stonewoods
popup.description: A small forest in [[Hunter's Hills]], on the edge of the [[Stonelands]].

popup.title: Orlath Wood
popup.description: Woods on the edge of the [[Great Sand Sea]].

popup.title: Vale of Lost Voices
popup.description: A sacred part of [[Cormanthor]] used as a burial place for honored [[elf]] [[warriors]] with [[Rauthauvyr's Road]] passing through the middle of it.

popup.title: Far Forest
popup.description: One of a group of three forests named the [[Triangle of Trees]]; it was full of small lakes, some of which had become stinking marshes infested by [[will-o'-wisp]]s and a few [[chuul]].

popup.title: Vordrorn Forest
popup.description: A small but dangerous forest of [[pine]] trees and muskeg bogs at the base of the [[Ice Mountains]].

popup.title: Cold Wood
popup.description: Or '''Glimmerwood''', a forest on the edge of the [[Silver Marches]] inhabited by [[barbarian]]s, [[ettin]]s, [[bebilith]]s, and various predatory beasts.

popup.title: Vercy Wood
popup.description: A forest of note on the border of the wider [[Ride]] and the Fallen Kingdom of [[Barze]].

popup.title: Samarlogh
popup.description: A dense and dangerous ruin-littered jungle that covered the northern rim of [[Samarach]], inhabited by [[corollax]]es and large carnivorous [[sloth]]s.

popup.title: Everwood
popup.description: Or '''Silverwood''', a small forest east of the [[Evermoors]].

popup.title: Weathercote Wood
popup.description: A forest of the [[Triangle of Trees]], located in the great expanse known as the [[Savage Frontier]] that existed from before the rise of [[Netheril]] and continued to endure despite the advancing of the desert of [[Anauroch]].

popup.title: The Dire Wood
popup.description: Also known as the '''Enchanted Wood''', an ancient and supernatural area within the [[High Forest]] found in the North.

popup.title: The Woods of Turlang
popup.description: A thicket located amongst the northwestern grouping of trees in the [[High Forest]], watched over by [[Turlang]], and over 100 other [[treant]]s.

popup.title: Tall Trees
popup.description: The northeastern section of the [[High Forest]] believed to contain the oldest [[tree]]s in the [[High Forest]].

popup.title: The Chultengar
popup.description: The branch of the main jungle of [[Chult]] that encroached on Thindol and Samarach, inhabited by [[spirit naga]]s, [[pterafolk]], [[wild dwarves]], [[wyvern]]s, and [[Batiri]].

popup.title: Charwood
popup.description: A southeastern portion of the [[Neverwinter Wood]].

popup.title: Neverwinter Wood
popup.description: Previously called '''Llewyrrwood''', a dense forest that possessed a sense of magic within it.

popup.title: Moonwood
popup.description: Part of the [[Glimmerwood]], joined with the [[Cold Wood]], dominated by [[evergreen]]s, [[shadowtop]]s, and [[duskwood]]s.

popup.title: Lurkwood
popup.description: Also known as '''Vurykvudd''' in the [[dwarven]] tongue, home to the [[Thunderbeast tribe]] dwelled within the wood.

popup.title: Druarwood
popup.description: A hillside forest, sparse and narrow, full of [[pine]], [[spruce]] firs, and [[conifer]]s.

popup.title: Earthwood
popup.description: A thick and fertile swiftly-growing forest that grew out of stony, hilly soil, ensorcelled by an ancient [[druid]].

popup.title: Dunwood
popup.description: Also known as '''The Rawlinswood''' prior to [[1479 DR]], a large forest in the north of the [[Great Dale]].

popup.title: Fell Wood
popup.description: A small haunted monster-infested wood in the mountains of the [[Spine of the World]].

popup.title: Watcher's Forest
popup.description: The part of the [[Neverwinter Wood]], tended by some residents of nearby [[Helm's Hold]].

popup.title: Erech Forest
popup.description: A dark and isolated forest on the edge of [[Rashemen]], inhabited by [[assassin vine]]s and s[[hambling mound]]s, as well as fearsome beasts like [[owlbear]]s, [[night hunter]]s, and at least one [[gray render]].

popup.title: Denderdale
popup.description: The narrowest point in [[Dunwood]], sometimes used by travelers as a shortcut through the forest.

popup.title: Urlingwood
popup.description: A wild, untamed forest that was considered to be of great importance to the [[Wychlaran]].

popup.title: Ashenwood
popup.description: A wild evergreen forest known for its large number of [[fey]] inhabitants and considered a sacred site filled with ancient magic.

popup.title: Waukeshire
popup.description: A small forest found within the [[Bloodstone Pass]] with the tunnel complexes of the [[Warren]] hidden underneath.

popup.title: Warrenwood
popup.description: Previously known as '''Sleepy Wood''', a small but densely overgrown forest within the [[Bloodstone Pass]].

popup.title: Banshee's Point
popup.description: The small forest on the southernmost point of [[Cape Velen]] with terrifying whaling heard by passing ships.

popup.title: Downdragon Rise
popup.description: The forest that grew at the heart of the [[Dragon's Head]] behind the ruined villas.

popup.title: Old Stone Wood
popup.description: A forest that contained the island's only ''[[moonwell]]'', located near the [[Cairn of Thelgaar Ironhand]].

popup.title: Greentree
popup.description: The northwestern part of [[Cormanthor]].

popup.title: Halvan's Wood
popup.description: The eastern part of [[Cormanthor]] that laid beyond river [[Duathamper]].

popup.title: Mytharan Woods
popup.description: An ancient deep woods that surrounded an ancient [[elf|elven]] tomb city – [[Myth Rhynn]].

popup.title: Torriage Wood
popup.description: A small forest located in the kingdom of [[Callidyrr]] on the island of [[Alaron]] that sheltered a single ''[[moonwell]]''.

popup.title: Rushdown Wood
popup.description: A small forest located in the kingdom of [[Callidyrr]].

popup.title: Winterglen
popup.description: The large forest that dominated the northeast corner of [[Gwynneth]].

popup.title: Pink Trees
popup.description: The outcropping of hot pink [[alder]]s, permanently transformed by [[Elistar Els'edranor]], a brilliant but scatter-brined [[wizard]], sometime before the mid-14{{th}} century [[DR]].

popup.title: The Dragon Wood
popup.description: A wooded ravine deep in the [[Evermoors]], named after the unusual megalith that floated at its center, called the [[Sleeping Dragon (artifact)|Sleeping Dragon]].

popup.title: Kelp Forest
popup.description: A deep underwater forest of [[kelp]] that belonged to the [[Dragon Reach]]'s [[aquatic elves]].

popup.title: Llyrath Forest
popup.description: The large forest that blanketed the southern coast of the isle of [[Gwynneth]], inhabited by few [[human]]s and wild animals such as [[boar]]s and [[bear]]s.

popup.title: Sacred Grove of the Earthmothe
popup.description: A small forest sacred to the [[Earthmother]] that contained one ''[[moonwell]]''.

popup.title: Oakvale
popup.description: A small forest within the [[Myrloch Vale]] due west of the [[Fens of the Fallen]] and surrounded to the south by [[the Highlands]] mountains.

popup.title: Toadstool Thicket
popup.description: A small forest in the shadow of the southern slopes of [[Aspenheight]] in western [[Gwynneth]] and a location of one of the ''[[moonwell]]s''.

popup.title: Shannyth Forest
popup.description: A woodland that provided the village of [[Farview]] with timber for the construction of fine [[longship]]s.

popup.title: Elfwood
popup.description: A small wood of note.

popup.title: Blackbranch
popup.description: A small forest of note.

popup.title: Blightwood
popup.description: A small forest of note.

popup.title: Warden's Wood
popup.description: A tiny wood by the hamlet of [[Warden]].

popup.title: Gerid's Trees
popup.description: A small forest that separated the hamlets of [[Shimmer Lake]] and [[Rushville]].

popup.title: Ghostlight Wood
popup.description: A small wood surrounded by farming hamlets.

popup.title: The Shalhoond
popup.description: Also called '''the Great Wild Wood''', claimed by no nation yet both [[Semphar]] and [[Murghom]] had settlements on the edges of the forest that produced lumber.

popup.title: Laednon
popup.description: A small wild forest northeast of the [[Moonwood]].

popup.title: Forest of Mir
popup.description: A dense forest named after the lost [[elven]] kingdom of [[Keltormir]] and the later [[human]] [[First Kingdom of Mir]].

popup.title: Urlingwood
popup.description: A wild, untamed forest in north [[Rashemen]] that was considered to be of great importance to the [[Wychlaran]], the order of witches that held great influence in the nation of the east.
